annotations.title: Redeem the claim and create the account

description: Redeem a claim once you have published one of its three proofs (a /.well-known file, a <meta> tag, or a DNS TXT record). On success it creates the account and the site and returns the tracking snippet to install. On a `feed` claim it also returns `feed`: what your secret, now the site's API key, opens. Idempotent — safe to retry. Requires the claim secret as a bearer token.
name: cromanion_verify_claim

feed.description: On a Live Visit Feed site only: what your secret, the site's API key, opens, and whether it opens anything yet.

apiKey.description: How to use the secret you already hold. The secret itself is never repeated.

consoleUrl.description: The site's page in the developer console: its switches and its keys.

enabled.description: Whether your human turned the feed on. Until they do, nothing leaves the site and every feed door answers feed_off.

humanActionUrl.description: While the feed is off: the link your human signs in through to turn it on.

note.description: While the feed is off: what to tell your human.

streamUrl.description: The Server-Sent Events stream, or null on a deployment with no edge.

snippet.description: Paste this before </body> on every page. Do not assemble your own.

provedBy.description: Which of the three proofs we actually read.

product.description: Present on a `feed` claim's site only.

status.description: `created` the first time, `existing` on a retry — the same account either way.
